<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function CLMCustomer360Controller($scope, $http, $timeout, $rootScope) {
    var c = this;

    // Two independent search boxes
    c.searchPan  = '';
    c.searchName = '';

    c.loading = true;
    c.charts  = {};

    // Suggestion state, split per box
    c.suggestionsPan     = [];
    c.suggestionsName    = [];
    c.suggestLoadingPan  = false;
    c.suggestLoadingName = false;
    var _suggestTimerPan  = null;
    var _suggestTimerName = null;

    // Month-End filter
    c.monthEndOptions  = [];
    c.selectedMonthEnd = null;

    // Customer-code filter (drives 12-month table + charts)
    c.selectedCode  = null;
    c.codeFilterText = '';

    var CHART_JS_URL = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.4/dist/chart.umd.min.js';

    function ensureChartJs(cb) {
        if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') { cb(); return; }

        if (!window.__clmChartJsPromise) {
            window.__clmChartJsPromise = new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
                var existing = document.querySelector('script[data-clm-chartjs]');
                if (existing) {
                    existing.addEventListener('load', resolve);
                    existing.addEventListener('error', reject);
                    return;
                }
                var script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = CHART_JS_URL;
                script.setAttribute('data-clm-chartjs', 'true');
                script.onload = resolve;
                script.onerror = reject;
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        window.__clmChartJsPromise.then(function() {
            $timeout(cb);
        }).catch(function(err) {
            console.error('CLM Widget: failed to load Chart.js from CDN', err);
        });
    }

    ensureChartJs(function() {});

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Formatters (unchanged)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.fmtLakh = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '—';
        var lakh = val / 100000;
        return '₹' + (Math.round(lakh * 10) / 10).toFixed(1) + 'L';
    };

    c.fmtK = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '—';
        if (val === 0) return '—';
        if (val >= 100000) return c.fmtLakh(val);
        return '₹' + Math.round(val / 1000) + 'K';
    };

    c.fmtDash = function(val) {
        return (!val || val === 0) ? '—' : c.fmtK(val);
    };

    c.statusClass = function(status) {
        var s = (status || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s.indexOf('submit') > -1 || s.indexOf('pend') > -1) return 'st-submitted';
        if (s.indexOf('approv') > -1) return 'st-approved';
        if (s.indexOf('return') > -1 || s.indexOf('send') > -1) return 'st-sendback';
        if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1) return 'st-rejected';
        return 'st-default';
    };

    c.monthEndLabel = function(val) {
        if (!val || !c.monthEndOptions) return '';
        var found = c.monthEndOptions.filter(function(m) { return m.value === val; })[0];
        return found ? found.label : val;
    };

    var parseSafeNumber = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return 0;
        if (typeof val === 'number') return isNaN(val) ? 0 : val;
        var str = String(val).replace(/[₹\s,]/g, '').trim();
        var multiplier = 1;
        if (str.toUpperCase().endsWith('L')) { multiplier = 100000; str = str.slice(0, -1); }
        else if (str.toUpperCase().endsWith('K')) { multiplier = 1000; str = str.slice(0, -1); }
        var num = parseFloat(str);
        return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num * multiplier;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Typeahead — shared logic, parameterised by which box triggered it
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.onTyping = function($event, which) {
        var isPan = (which === 'pan');
        var term = (isPan ? c.searchPan : c.searchName || '').trim();
        // (searchPan/searchName read fresh below since ternary above only reads once)
        term = (isPan ? (c.searchPan || '') : (c.searchName || '')).trim();

        if ($event.keyCode === 13) {
            if (isPan) c.suggestionsPan = []; else c.suggestionsName = [];
            c.doSearch();
            return;
        }
        if ($event.keyCode === 27) {
            if (isPan) c.suggestionsPan = []; else c.suggestionsName = [];
            return;
        }

        if (term.length < 2) {
            if (isPan) { c.suggestionsPan = []; c.suggestLoadingPan = false; if (_suggestTimerPan) $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimerPan); }
            else { c.suggestionsName = []; c.suggestLoadingName = false; if (_suggestTimerName) $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimerName); }
            return;
        }

        if (isPan) {
            if (_suggestTimerPan) $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimerPan);
            _suggestTimerPan = $timeout(function() {
                c.suggestLoadingPan = true;
                c.server.get({ action: 'suggest', term: term, field: 'pan' }).then(function(r) {
                    c.suggestionsPan = r.data.suggestions || [];
                    c.suggestLoadingPan = false;
                }, function() { c.suggestionsPan = []; c.suggestLoadingPan = false; });
            }, 250);
        } else {
            if (_suggestTimerName) $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimerName);
            _suggestTimerName = $timeout(function() {
                c.suggestLoadingName = true;
                c.server.get({ action: 'suggest', term: term, field: 'name' }).then(function(r) {
                    c.suggestionsName = r.data.suggestions || [];
                    c.suggestLoadingName = false;
                }, function() { c.suggestionsName = []; c.suggestLoadingName = false; });
            }, 250);
        }
    };

    c.selectSuggestion = function(s) {
        c.suggestionsPan  = [];
        c.suggestionsName = [];
        c.searchPan  = '';
        c.searchName = '';
        c.load({ sysId: s.sysId, code: s.code });
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Main load — resolves to the PAN and loads the full aggregated view
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.load = function(param) {
        c.loading = true;
        c.suggestionsPan  = [];
        c.suggestionsName = [];

        var payload = { monthEnd: c.selectedMonthEnd };

        if (param && typeof param === 'object' && param.requestNumber) {
            payload.requestNumber = param.requestNumber;
        } else if (param && typeof param === 'object' && param.sysId) {
            payload.sysId = param.sysId;
        } else if (param && typeof param === 'object' && param.pan) {
            payload.pan = param.pan;
        } else if (param && typeof param === 'object' && param.name) {
            payload.name = param.name;
        } else {
            payload.search = param || '';
        }

        c.server.get(payload).then(function(r) {
            c.data = r.data;
            c.loading = false;
            c.monthEndOptions  = r.data.monthEndOptions || [];
            c.selectedMonthEnd = r.data.selectedMonthEnd || c.selectedMonthEnd;
            c.selectedCode     = r.data.selectedCode || null;
            c.codeFilterText   = '';
            $timeout(function() {
                c.drawSalesChart();
                c.drawAgingChart();
            }, 300);
        });
    };

    c.doSearch = function() {
        var pan  = (c.searchPan || '').trim();
        var name = (c.searchName || '').trim();
        if (pan) {
            c.load({ pan: pan });
        } else if (name) {
            c.load({ name: name });
        }
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Month-End filter change — refreshes KPI tiles + Site Codes table only
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.onMonthEndChange = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.customer || !c.data.customer.pan) return;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'monthend',
            pan: c.data.customer.pan,
            monthEnd: c.selectedMonthEnd
        }).then(function(r) {
            c.data.indicators = r.data.indicators;
            c.data.siteCodes  = r.data.siteCodes;
        });
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Customer-code filter change (under 12-month table, or row click
    // in the Site Codes table) — refreshes trend table + redraws charts
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.onSelectedCodeChange = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.customer || !c.data.customer.pan || !c.selectedCode) return;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'selectcode',
            pan: c.data.customer.pan,
            code: c.selectedCode
        }).then(function(r) {
            c.data.monthly = r.data.monthly;
            $timeout(function() {
                c.drawSalesChart();
                c.drawAgingChart();
            }, 100);
        });
    };

    c.selectSiteCodeRow = function(row) {
        if (!row || row.code === c.selectedCode) return;
        c.selectedCode = row.code;
        c.onSelectedCodeChange();
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Charts (unchanged rendering logic, still fed from c.data.monthly)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    c.drawSalesChart = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.monthly || !c.data.monthly.length) return;

        ensureChartJs(function() {
            var canvas = document.getElementById('c360SalesChart');
            if (!canvas) return;

            var existing = Chart.getChart(canvas);
            if (existing) existing.destroy();

            var rows = c.data.monthly.slice(-6);
            var chartLabels = rows.map(function(r) { return r.month || ''; });
            var volumeData  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.salesVolume); });
            var valueData   = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.salesValue); });

            c.charts.sales = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: chartLabels,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: 'Sales Volume (MT)',
                            data: volumeData,
                            borderColor: '#1f7a4d',
                            backgroundColor: '#1f7a4d',
                            fill: false,
                            yAxisID: 'ySalesVolume',
                            tension: 0.2
                        },
                        {
                            label: 'Sales Value',
                            data: valueData,
                            borderColor: '#1c4e9c',
                            backgroundColor: '#1c4e9c',
                            fill: false,
                            yAxisID: 'ySalesValue',
                            tension: 0.2
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    resizeDelay: 0,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: true, position: 'bottom' },
                        tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: { grid: { color: '#e2e8f0' } },
                        ySalesVolume: {
                            type: 'linear',
                            position: 'left',
                            grid: { color: '#e2e8f0' },
                            title: { display: true, text: 'Sales Volume (MT)' }
                        },
                        ySalesValue: {
                            type: 'linear',
                            position: 'right',
                            grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
                            title: { display: true, text: 'Sales Value (₹)' }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    };

    c.drawAgingChart = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.monthly || !c.data.monthly.length) return;

        ensureChartJs(function() {
            var canvas = document.getElementById('c360AgingChart');
            if (!canvas) return;

            var existing = Chart.getChart(canvas);
            if (existing) existing.destroy();

            var rows = c.data.monthly.slice(-6);
            var chartLabels = rows.map(function(r) { return r.month || ''; });
            var b0_30_Data  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b0_30); });
            var b31_45_Data = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b31_45 || r.b31_60); });
            var b46_60_Data = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b46_60 || r.b61_90); });
            var b91_p_Data  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b91_p); });

            c.charts.aging = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: chartLabels,
                    datasets: [
                        { label: '0-30D',  data: b0_30_Data,  backgroundColor: '#449e62' },
                        { label: '31-45D', data: b31_45_Data, backgroundColor: '#e29b45' },
                        { label: '46-60D', data: b46_60_Data, backgroundColor: '#d16b34' },
                        { label: '>90D',   data: b91_p_Data,  backgroundColor: '#c23737' }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    resizeDelay: 0,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: true, position: 'bottom' },
                        tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: { stacked: true, grid: { display: false } },
                        y: {
                            stacked: true,
                            grid: { color: '#e2e8f0' },
                            title: { display: true, text: 'Outstanding Amount (₹)' }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Entry points from Portfolio Overview tab / other widgets (unchanged)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    $rootScope.$on('clm.customer.selected', function(event, payload) {
        if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && payload.sysId) {
            c.load({ sysId: payload.sysId, code: payload.code });
        } else if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && payload.requestNumber) {
            c.load({ requestNumber: payload.requestNumber, code: payload.code });
        } else {
            c.load(payload);
        }
    });

    $rootScope.$on('clm.request.selected', function(event, payload) {
        if (payload && payload.number) {
            c.load({ requestNumber: payload.number });
        }
    });

    if ($rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId) {
        var pendingSysId = $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId;
        var pendingCode  = $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerCode;
        delete $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId;
        delete $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerCode;
        c.load({ sysId: pendingSysId, code: pendingCode });
    } else if ($rootScope.clmPendingRequestNumber) {
        var pendingReqNum = $rootScope.clmPendingRequestNumber;
        delete $rootScope.clmPendingRequestNumber;
        c.load({ requestNumber: pendingReqNum });
    } else {
        c.load();
    }
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================
   CLM C360 Base Styles
   ========================================= */
.clm-c360 {
    font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    background: #f4f5f7;
    padding: 20px;
}

.clm-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
}

.clm-error {
    padding: 16px;
    color: #b3261e;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-left: 4px solid #b3261e;
}

.clm-initial-hint {
    padding: 24px;
    text-align: center;
    color: #718096;
    font-size: 13px;
}

/* =========================================
   Search Bar & Customer Header
   ========================================= */
.clm-searchbar { padding: 12px 16px; }
.clm-search-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.clm-search-icon { font-size: 16px; }
.clm-search-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; color: #4a5568; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.clm-search-input {
    flex: 0 1 300px;
    height: 36px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.clm-search-input:focus {
    border-color: #1c4e9c;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(28, 78, 156, 0.12);
}

.clm-btn-primary {
    background: #1c4e9c;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    height: 36px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.clm-btn-primary:hover { background: #163d7a; }

.clm-search-helper { font-size: 12px; color: #718096; margin-left: 10px; }

/* Request-lookup context banner */
.clm-request-banner {
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    background: #ebf8ff;
    border: 1px solid #bee3f8;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: #2b6cb0;
    display: inline-block;
}
.clm-req-status { font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
.clm-req-status.st-submitted { background: #e6efff; color: #2f6fed; }
.clm-req-status.st-approved  { background: #e6f7ee; color: #1e9e5a; }
.clm-req-status.st-pending   { background: #fff3e0; color: #d97b0d; }
.clm-req-status.st-sendback  { background: #f1eaff; color: #7c5cf0; }
.clm-req-status.st-rejected  { background: #fdeaea; color: #dc3545; }
.clm-req-status.st-default   { background: #f3f4f6; color: #6b7280; }

.clm-customer-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
}
.clm-customer-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.clm-viewing { font-size: 13px; color: #718096; }
.clm-customer-name { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; }
.clm-badge { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.clm-badge-blue { background: #ebf8ff; color: #2b6cb0; }
.clm-badge-yellow { background: #fefcbf; color: #975a16; }

.clm-customer-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.clm-header-meta { font-size: 13px; color: #4a5568; }

/* =========================================
   KPI Tiles
   ========================================= */
.clm-tiles {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.clm-tile {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-top: 4px solid #cbd5e0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
}

.clm-tile-blue { border-top-color: #1c4e9c; }
.clm-tile-orange { border-top-color: #e08a1e; }
.clm-tile-green { border-top-color: #1f9d55; }
.clm-tile-green-light { border-top-color: #3bb273; }
.clm-tile-teal { border-top-color: #0f9d8e; }

.clm-tile-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
.clm-tile-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }

.clm-text-blue { color: #2b6cb0; }
.clm-text-orange { color: #dd6b20; }
.clm-text-orange-dark { color: #c05621; }
.clm-text-green { color: #38a169; }
.clm-text-teal { color: #319795; }
.clm-text-red { color: #e53e3e; }

/* =========================================
   Charts Section
   ========================================= */
.clm-chart-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
}

.clm-chart-card { padding: 0; }

.clm-chart-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.clm-chart-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #805ad5;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.clm-chart-wrapper {
    padding: 10px 16px 16px;
}

.clm-svg { width: 100%; height: 240px; }
.clm-line-blue { fill: none; stroke: #3182ce; stroke-width: 2; }
.clm-line-green { fill: none; stroke: #38a169; stroke-width: 2; }
.clm-axis-label { font-size: 10px; fill: #718096; font-weight: 500;}
.clm-grid-line { stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1; }

/* =========================================
   Data Table
   ========================================= */
.clm-table-card { padding: 0; }

.clm-table-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
}

.clm-table-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; }

.clm-table-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #718096;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    padding: 2px 8px;

    /* ============================================================
       NSH CUSTOMER 360 WIDGET — SERVER SCRIPT (PAN-aggregated view)
       ============================================================ */
    var TABLES = {
        master:      'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1',
        request:     'x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request',
        aging:       'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot',
        roleMap:     'x_birl3_clm_role_user_mapping',
        salesVolume: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_sales_data',
        salesValue:  'x_birl3_clm_clm_cement_rmc_bpd_values'
    };

    var FIELDS = {
        custCode:     'customer_code_sap',
        custName:     'customer_name',
        custPan:      'pan',
        custSegment:  'segment',
        custZone:     'zone',
        custZoneName: 'zone_name',
        custRegion:   'region',
        custRegionName: 'region_name',
        custDepot:    'depot',
        custDepotName: 'depot_name',
        custSalesOrg: 'salesorg',
        systemMultiplier: 'system_multiplier',

        agingCustomer:    'customer',
        snapshotMonth:    'snapshot_month',
        totalOutstanding: 'total_outstanding',
        bucket0_30:       'bucket_0_30_days',
        bucket31_45:      'bucket_31_45_days',
        bucket46_60:      'bucket_46_60_days',
        bucket61_75:      'bucket_61_75_days',
        bucket76_90:      'bucket_76_90_days',
        bucket91_120:     'bucket_91_120_days',
        bucketGt120:      'bucket_gt120_days',

        salesRecordCustomer: 'u_customer'
    };

    var MONTH_ABBR  = ['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'];
    var MONTH_LABEL = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

    var REQ_NUMBER_FIELD = 'number';
    var REQ_CUSTOMER_FIELD = 'customer';
    var REQ_STATE_FIELD = 'state';

    var currentUserId = gs.getUserID();

    function monthKey(year, monthIdx0) {
        return MONTH_ABBR[monthIdx0] + '_' + String(year).slice(-2);
    }

    function monthLabel(year, monthIdx0) {
        return MONTH_LABEL[monthIdx0] + '-' + String(year).slice(-2);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Dynamic "last N completed months" — always excludes the current,
    // still-in-progress month. E.g. run in Aug 2026 with n=6 returns
    // Feb-26 .. Jul-26. Once September starts, the window shifts to
    // Mar-26 .. Aug-26 automatically.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getRecentCompletedMonths(n) {
        var out = [];
        var now = new Date();
        for (var i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
            var d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
            out.push({
                suffix: monthKey(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()),
                label:  monthLabel(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()),
                value:  monthKey(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth())
            });
        }
        return out;
    }

    function getMonthlyFieldValue(gr, monthSuffix) {
        if (!gr || !monthSuffix) return null;
        var fieldName = 'u_' + monthSuffix;
        if (!gr.isValidField(fieldName)) return null;
        var raw = gr.getValue(fieldName);
        if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === '') return null;
        var num = parseFloat(raw);
        return isNaN(num) ? null : num;
    }

    function getMonthFieldSuffixFromDate(dateVal) {
        if (!dateVal) return null;
        var datePart = String(dateVal).split(' ')[0];
        var pieces = datePart.split('-');
        if (pieces.length < 2) return null;
        var year  = parseInt(pieces[0], 10);
        var month = parseInt(pieces[1], 10);
        if (isNaN(year) || isNaN(month) || month < 1 || month > 12) return null;
        return monthKey(year, month - 1);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Live SAP credit call — unchanged, but asdAmount is now surfaced
    // as the "Active SD" KPI (previously fetched but unused).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getLiveCreditData(customerCode, salesOrg) {
        var out = {
            creditLimit: 0, outstandingAmount: 0, availableCredit: 0,
            asdAmount: 0, state: '', raw: null, success: false
        };

        var custCodeClean = customerCode ? String(customerCode).trim() : '';
        var salesOrgClean = salesOrg ? String(salesOrg).trim() : '';

        if (!custCodeClean) {
            gs.error('[NSH Customer 360] getLiveCreditData called with no customer code.');
            return out;
        }
        if (!salesOrgClean) {
            gs.warn('[NSH Customer 360] Customer ' + custCodeClean + ' has no salesorg value — calling API with empty SalesOrg.');
        }

        try {
            var apiCall = new x_birl3_clm.CLM_NEW_WSDL1();
            var rawResult = apiCall.getCreditDetails(custCodeClean, salesOrgClean);

            if (!rawResult) {
                gs.error('[NSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 returned empty for ' + custCodeClean + '/' + salesOrgClean + '.');
                return out;
            }

            var parsed = JSON.parse(rawResult);
            out.creditLimit       = parseFloat(parsed.creditLimit) || 0;
            out.outstandingAmount = parseFloat(parsed.outstandingAmount) || 0;
            out.availableCredit   = parseFloat(parsed.availableCredit) || 0;
            out.asdAmount         = parseFloat(parsed.ASDAmount) || 0;
            out.state             = parsed.state || '';
            out.raw = parsed;

            var allBlank = true;
            for (var k in parsed) { if (parsed[k]) { allBlank = false; break; } }
            if (!allBlank) { out.success = true; }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[NSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 exception for ' + custCodeClean + '/' + salesOrgClean + ': ' + e.message);
        }

        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Multi-strategy lookup for a sales-table row (unchanged logic)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function findSalesRow(tableName, custCode, custSysId) {
        var custCodeTrim = custCode ? String(custCode).trim() : '';

        if (custCodeTrim) {
            var gr1 = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            gr1.addQuery(FIELDS.salesRecordCustomer, custCodeTrim);
            gr1.setLimit(1);
            gr1.query();
            if (gr1.next()) return gr1;
        }
        if (custCodeTrim) {
            var gr2 = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            gr2.addQuery(FIELDS.salesRecordCustomer, 'CONTAINS', custCodeTrim);
            gr2.setLimit(1);
            gr2.query();
            if (gr2.next()) return gr2;
        }
        if (custSysId) {
            var gr3 = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            gr3.addQuery(FIELDS.salesRecordCustomer, custSysId);
            gr3.setLimit(1);
            gr3.query();
            if (gr3.next()) return gr3;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Aging snapshot for one customer sys_id, indexed by month suffix
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getAgingByMonth(custSysId) {
        var byMonth = {};
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLES.aging);
        gr.addQuery(FIELDS.agingCustomer, custSysId);
        gr.orderByDesc(FIELDS.snapshotMonth);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var mKey = getMonthFieldSuffixFromDate(gr.getValue(FIELDS.snapshotMonth));
            if (mKey && !byMonth[mKey]) {
                byMonth[mKey] = {
                    totalOutstanding: parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.totalOutstanding)) || 0,
                    b0:   parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket0_30))   || 0,
                    b31:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket31_45))  || 0,
                    b46:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket46_60))  || 0,
                    b61:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket61_75))  || 0,
                    b76:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket76_90))  || 0,
                    b91:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucket91_120)) || 0,
                    b120: parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.bucketGt120))  || 0
                };
            }
        }
        return byMonth;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // All master records that share a PAN
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getMasterRecordsByPan(panVal) {
        var list = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        gr.addQuery(FIELDS.custPan, panVal);
        gr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            list.push({
                sysId:   gr.getUniqueValue(),
                code:    gr.getValue(FIELDS.custCode),
                name:    gr.getValue(FIELDS.custName),
                pan:     gr.getValue(FIELDS.custPan),
                segment: gr.getDisplayValue(FIELDS.custSegment),
                zone:    gr.getValue(FIELDS.custZoneName) || gr.getValue(FIELDS.custZone),
                region:  gr.getValue(FIELDS.custRegionName) || gr.getValue(FIELDS.custRegion),
                depot:   gr.getValue(FIELDS.custDepotName) || gr.getValue(FIELDS.custDepot),
                salesOrg: gr.getValue(FIELDS.custSalesOrg),
                createdOn: gr.getValue('sys_created_on')
            });
        }
        return list;
    }

    function getSdMultiplierForCustomer(custSysId) {
        var mult = 0;
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLES.request);
        gr.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            mult = parseFloat(gr.getValue(FIELDS.systemMultiplier)) || 0;
        }
        return mult;
    }

    function getLatestRequestContext(custSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLES.request);
        gr.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            var stateVal   = gr.getValue(REQ_STATE_FIELD);
            var stateLabel = gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_STATE_FIELD);
            if ((stateVal || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('submit') > -1) { stateLabel = 'Pending'; }
            return { number: gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_NUMBER_FIELD), status: stateVal, statusLabel: stateLabel };
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Build one "Site Codes under PAN" row for a given master record,
    // "as of" a specific completed month (aging snapshot + sales data),
    // with Credit Limit / Active SD always LIVE from SAP.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildSiteCodeRow(masterRec, monthSuffix) {
        var live = getLiveCreditData(masterRec.code, masterRec.salesOrg);
        var agingByMonth = getAgingByMonth(masterRec.sysId);
        var agingEntry = agingByMonth[monthSuffix] || null;

        var salesVolGr = findSalesRow(TABLES.salesVolume, masterRec.code, masterRec.sysId);
        var salesValGr = findSalesRow(TABLES.salesValue, masterRec.code, masterRec.sysId);
        var salesVolumeVal = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesVolGr, monthSuffix) || 0;
        var salesValueVal  = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesValGr, monthSuffix) || 0;

        // Historical outstanding comes from the aging snapshot for that
        // month where available; falls back to the live SAP figure if
        // no snapshot exists yet for the selected month.
        var outstanding = agingEntry ? agingEntry.totalOutstanding : live.outstandingAmount;
        var b0_30  = agingEntry ? agingEntry.b0 : 0;
        var b31_45 = agingEntry ? agingEntry.b31 : 0;
        var b46_60 = agingEntry ? agingEntry.b46 : 0;
        var b91_p  = agingEntry ? (agingEntry.b91 + agingEntry.b120) : 0;
        var b61_90 = agingEntry ? (agingEntry.b61 + agingEntry.b76) : 0;

        // NOT DUE = current-not-yet-overdue portion of the outstanding
        // balance (outstanding minus everything already aged past 0-30).
        var notDue = outstanding - (b0_30 + b31_45 + b46_60 + b61_90 + b91_p);
        if (notDue < 0) notDue = 0;

        return {
            code: masterRec.code,
            sysId: masterRec.sysId,
            segment: masterRec.segment,
            zone: masterRec.zone,
            region: masterRec.region,
            limit: live.creditLimit,
            activeSD: live.asdAmount,
            outstanding: outstanding,
            notDue: notDue,
            b0_30: b0_30,
            b31_45: b31_45,
            b46_60: b46_60,
            b61_90: b61_90,
            b91_p: b91_p,
            sdMultiplier: getSdMultiplierForCustomer(masterRec.sysId),
            salesVolume: salesVolumeVal,
            salesValue: salesValueVal
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Aggregate indicators across ALL site codes under a PAN, for a
    // given selected month-end. Active SD is always live/current.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildAggregatedIndicators(masterList, monthSuffix) {
        var rows = masterList.map(function(m) { return buildSiteCodeRow(m, monthSuffix); });

        var sumLimit = 0, sumOutstanding = 0, sumOd90 = 0, sumActiveSD = 0, sumMultiplier = 0;
        rows.forEach(function(r) {
            sumLimit       += r.limit;
            sumOutstanding += r.outstanding;
            sumOd90        += r.b91_p;
            sumActiveSD    += r.activeSD;
            sumMultiplier  += r.sdMultiplier;
        });

        var avgMultiplier = rows.length > 0 ? (Math.round((sumMultiplier / rows.length) * 100) / 100) : 0;

        return {
            indicators: {
                limit:        sumLimit,
                outstanding:  sumOutstanding,
                available:    sumLimit - sumOutstanding,
                utilisation:  sumLimit > 0 ? Math.round((sumOutstanding / sumLimit) * 100) : 0,
                sdMultiplier: avgMultiplier,
                activeSD:     sumActiveSD,
                od90:         sumOd90,
                od90Clean:    sumOd90 <= 0
            },
            siteCodes: rows
        };
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6-completed-month trend for a SINGLE customer code (feeds charts
    // and the 12-Month Detail Table). Structure matches original output.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildMonthlyTrend(masterRec) {
        var live = getLiveCreditData(masterRec.code, masterRec.salesOrg);
        var reqLimit       = live.creditLimit;
        var reqOutstanding = live.outstandingAmount;

        var agingByMonth = getAgingByMonth(masterRec.sysId);
        var salesVolGr = findSalesRow(TABLES.salesVolume, masterRec.code, masterRec.sysId);
        var salesValGr = findSalesRow(TABLES.salesValue, masterRec.code, masterRec.sysId);

        var monthDefs = getRecentCompletedMonths(6);
        var rows = [];

        for (var mi = 0; mi < monthDefs.length; mi++) {
            var def = monthDefs[mi];
            var agingEntry = agingByMonth[def.suffix] || null;

            var salesVolumeVal = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesVolGr, def.suffix);
            var salesValueVal  = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesValGr, def.suffix);

            // Historical outstanding preferred from the snapshot when
            // present, otherwise falls back to the live figure (same
            // limitation as the original widget: no historical Credit
            // Limit table exists, so limit is repeated across months).
            var monthOutstanding = agingEntry ? agingEntry.totalOutstanding : reqOutstanding;

            rows.push({
                month:       def.label,
                limit:       reqLimit,
                outstanding: monthOutstanding,
                salesVolume: salesVolumeVal || 0,
                salesValue:  salesValueVal || 0,
                b0_30:  agingEntry ? agingEntry.b0 : 0,
                b31_45: agingEntry ? agingEntry.b31 : 0,
                b46_60: agingEntry ? agingEntry.b46 : 0,
                b61_90: agingEntry ? (agingEntry.b61 + agingEntry.b76) : 0,
                b91_p:  agingEntry ? (agingEntry.b91 + agingEntry.b120) : 0,
                util: reqLimit > 0 ? Math.round((monthOutstanding / reqLimit) * 100) : 0
            });
        }
        return rows;
    }

    function buildCustomerHeader(masterList, primaryRec) {
        var names = masterList.map(function(m) { return m.name; }).filter(function(n) { return !!n; });
        var distinctNames = names.filter(function(v, i) { return names.indexOf(v) === i; });
        var otherNames = distinctNames.filter(function(n) { return n !== primaryRec.name; });

        var segments = masterList.map(function(m) { return m.segment; }).filter(function(s) { return !!s; });
        var distinctSegments = segments.filter(function(v, i) { return segments.indexOf(v) === i; });

        return {
            name: primaryRec.name,
            pan: primaryRec.pan,
            code: primaryRec.code,
            segmentsLabel: distinctSegments.join(', '),
            zone: primaryRec.zone,
            region: primaryRec.region,
            depot: primaryRec.depot,
            siteCodeCount: masterList.length,
            otherNames: otherNames
        };
    }

    // =========================================================
    // STEP 0: Role/access check
    // =========================================================
    var ALLOWED_ROLES = ['NSH', 'HEAD_RMC', 'HEAD_KEY_CH_RMC', 'HSBPD', 'HBPD'];
    var isAuthorized = false;

    var grRole = new GlideRecord(TABLES.roleMap);
    grRole.addQuery('u_user', currentUserId);
    grRole.addQuery('u_role', 'IN', ALLOWED_ROLES);
    grRole.query();
    if (grRole.next()) { isAuthorized = true; }

    if (!isAuthorized) {
        data.error = 'You do not have access to view this dashboard.';
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TYPEAHEAD branch (used by both the PAN box and the Name box)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (input && input.action === 'suggest') {
        var term = (input.term || '').trim();
        data.suggestions = [];
        if (term.length < 2) { return; }

        var grSug = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        if (input.field === 'pan') {
            var qSug = grSug.addQuery(FIELDS.custPan, 'STARTSWITH', term);
            qSug.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custPan, 'CONTAINS', term);
        } else {
            var qSug2 = grSug.addQuery(FIELDS.custName, 'STARTSWITH', term);
            qSug2.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custName, 'CONTAINS', term);
            qSug2.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custCode, 'STARTSWITH', term);
        }
        grSug.orderBy(FIELDS.custName);
        grSug.setLimit(8);
        grSug.query();

        var seen = {};
        while (grSug.next()) {
            var code = grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custCode);
            if (seen[code]) { continue; }
            seen[code] = true;
            data.suggestions.push({
                sysId: grSug.getUniqueValue(),
                name: grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custName),
                code: code,
                pan:  grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custPan)
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // MONTH-END REFRESH branch — recompute KPI tiles + Site Codes table
    // only, for an already-loaded PAN.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (input && input.action === 'monthend') {
        var panForMonthEnd = (input.pan || '').trim();
        var monthEndVal = (input.monthEnd || '').trim();
        if (!panForMonthEnd || !monthEndVal) { data.error = 'Missing PAN or Month-End value.'; return; }

        var masterListME = getMasterRecordsByPan(panForMonthEnd);
        if (masterListME.length === 0) { data.error = 'No customer found for this PAN.'; return; }

        var aggME = buildAggregatedIndicators(masterListME, monthEndVal);
        data.indicators = aggME.indicators;
        data.siteCodes  = aggME.siteCodes;
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // SELECT-CODE REFRESH branch — recompute the 12-month trend table
    // (and hence charts) for one customer code within the current PAN.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (input && input.action === 'selectcode') {
        var panForCode = (input.pan || '').trim();
        var codeVal = (input.code || '').trim();
        if (!panForCode || !codeVal) { data.error = 'Missing PAN or customer code.'; return; }

        var masterListSC = getMasterRecordsByPan(panForCode);
        var matchRec = masterListSC.filter(function(m) { return m.code === codeVal; })[0];
        if (!matchRec) { data.error = 'Customer code not found under this PAN.'; return; }

        data.monthly = buildMonthlyTrend(matchRec);
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // FULL LOAD branch
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    data.error = null;
    data.initialLoad = false;
    data.customer = null;
    data.requestContext = null;
    data.monthEndOptions = getRecentCompletedMonths(6);
    data.selectedMonthEnd = (input && input.monthEnd) ? input.monthEnd
        : data.monthEndOptions[data.monthEndOptions.length - 1].value;

    var directSysId   = (input && input.sysId) ? input.sysId : '';
    var requestNumber = (input && input.requestNumber) ? input.requestNumber.trim() : '';
    var panInput       = (input && input.pan) ? input.pan.trim() : '';
    var nameInput       = (input && input.name) ? input.name.trim() : '';
    var rawSearch = (input && input.search) ? input.search : (options.search || options.customer_code || $sp.getParameter('search') || '');
    var searchTerm = rawSearch.trim();

    if (!directSysId && !searchTerm && !requestNumber && !panInput && !nameInput) {
        data.initialLoad = true;
        return;
    }

    var resolvedSysId = null; // the specific master record the user targeted, if any

    // =========================================================
    // PATH A: Opened via Request Number
    // =========================================================
    if (requestNumber) {
        var grReqLookup = new GlideRecord(TABLES.request);
        grReqLookup.addQuery(REQ_NUMBER_FIELD, requestNumber);
        grReqLookup.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grReqLookup.setLimit(1);
        grReqLookup.query();

        if (!grReqLookup.next()) {
            data.error = 'No request found matching "' + requestNumber + '".';
            return;
        }

        var reqStateVal   = grReqLookup.getValue(REQ_STATE_FIELD);
        var reqStateLabel = grReqLookup.getDisplayValue(REQ_STATE_FIELD);
        if ((reqStateVal || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('submit') > -1) { reqStateLabel = 'Pending'; }

        data.requestContext = {
            number: grReqLookup.getDisplayValue(REQ_NUMBER_FIELD),
            status: reqStateVal,
            statusLabel: reqStateLabel
        };

        var linkedCustId = grReqLookup.getValue(REQ_CUSTOMER_FIELD);
        if (!linkedCustId) {
            data.error = 'Request ' + requestNumber + ' has no linked customer.';
            gs.warn('[NSH Customer 360] Request ' + requestNumber + ' has no linked customer.');
            return;
        }
        resolvedSysId = linkedCustId;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // PATH B: Direct sys_id (from typeahead selection)
    // =========================================================
    else if (directSysId) {
        resolvedSysId = directSysId;
    }

    // =========================================================
    // PATH C: PAN search box
    // =========================================================
    else if (panInput) {
        var grPan = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        var qPan = grPan.addQuery(FIELDS.custPan, panInput);
        qPan.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custPan, 'STARTSWITH', panInput);
        grPan.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        grPan.setLimit(1);
        grPan.query();
        if (!grPan.next()) {
            data.error = 'No customer found matching PAN "' + panInput + '".';
            return;
        }
        resolvedSysId = grPan.getUniqueValue();
    }

    // =========================================================
    // PATH D: Customer Name search box
    // =========================================================
    else if (nameInput) {
        var grName = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        grName.addQuery(FIELDS.custName, 'CONTAINS', nameInput);
        grName.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grName.setLimit(1);
        grName.query();
        if (!grName.next()) {
            data.error = 'No customer found matching name "' + nameInput + '".';
            return;
        }
        resolvedSysId = grName.getUniqueValue();
    }

    // =========================================================
    // PATH E: Generic search (legacy support: code / pan / name)
    // =========================================================
    else if (searchTerm) {
        var grGeneric = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        var qg = grGeneric.addQuery(FIELDS.custCode, searchTerm);
        qg.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custPan, searchTerm);
        qg.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custName, 'CONTAINS', searchTerm);
        grGeneric.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grGeneric.setLimit(1);
        grGeneric.query();
        if (!grGeneric.next()) {
            data.error = 'No customer found matching "' + searchTerm + '".';
            return;
        }
        resolvedSysId = grGeneric.getUniqueValue();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Load the targeted master record, find its PAN, then pull EVERY
    // master record sharing that PAN.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var grTarget = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
    if (!grTarget.get(resolvedSysId)) {
        data.error = 'Customer record not found.';
        return;
    }
    var targetCode = grTarget.getValue(FIELDS.custCode);
    var panVal = grTarget.getValue(FIELDS.custPan);

    if (!panVal) {
        data.error = 'This customer has no PAN on record — cannot build a PAN view.';
        return;
    }

    var masterList = getMasterRecordsByPan(panVal);
    if (masterList.length === 0) {
        data.error = 'No customer found for PAN "' + panVal + '".';
        return;
    }

    var primaryRec = masterList.filter(function(m) { return m.code === targetCode; })[0] || masterList[0];

    data.customer = buildCustomerHeader(masterList, primaryRec);

    // Request-context banner: use the linked request if we came in via
    // Request Number, otherwise show the primary customer's latest request.
    if (!data.requestContext) {
        data.requestContext = getLatestRequestContext(primaryRec.sysId);
    }

    // KPI tiles + Site Codes table — aggregated as of selected month-end
    var agg = buildAggregatedIndicators(masterList, data.selectedMonthEnd);
    data.indicators = agg.indicators;
    data.siteCodes  = agg.siteCodes;

    // Customer-code filter list for the 12-Month Detail Table
    data.customerCodesList = masterList.map(function(m) {
        return { sysId: m.sysId, code: m.code, name: m.name };
    });

    // 12-Month Detail Table + charts default to the targeted/primary code
    data.selectedCode = primaryRec.code;
    data.monthly = buildMonthlyTrend(primaryRec);
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-04 09:48:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>6b4319302b6a87904572f3745e91bffa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>clm_pan_customer360</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_6b4319302b6a87904572f3745e91bffa</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>devendra.pandey@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-04 10:37:25</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="clm-c360">

            <div class="clm-scroll-table-wrapper">
                <table class="clm-table clm-sticky-table">

        <div class="clm-chart-row">

                <div class="clm-chart-title">

                    <span class="clm-chart-tag">Dual-Axis Line</span>
                </div>
                <div class="clm-chart-wrapper" style="position: relative; height: 240px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px;">
                    <canvas id="c360SalesChart"></canvas>

            <div class="clm-card clm-chart-card">
                <div class="clm-chart-title">
                    Aging Breakdown (6M) <span class="clm-chart-context">· {{c.selectedCode}}</span>
                    <span class="clm-chart-tag-green" style="font-size: 11px; color: #1f7a4d; background: #e3f4ea; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600;">Stacked Bar</span>
                </div>
                <div class="clm-chart-wrapper" style="position: relative; height: 240px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px;">
                    <canvas id="c360AgingChart"></canvas>
                </div>

        <!-- ============================================================
             12-MONTH DETAIL TABLE (per selected customer code)

            <div class="clm-code-filter-row" ng-if="c.data.customerCodesList && c.data.customerCodesList.length > 1">

            </table>
        </div>

    </div>

    <div ng-if="!c.data.error && c.data.initialLoad" class="clm-card clm-initial-hint">
        Search by PAN or Customer Name above — or click a Request No. from the Portfolio Overview tab.
    </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>6b4319302b6a87904572f3745e91bffa</id><sys_created_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-04 09:48:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>6f4359302b6a87904572f3745e91bf00</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-04 09:48:41</sys_updated_on><table>sp_widget</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>
